neutralSampling: the two engines are NOT sampled identically. Verified 2026-07-10 against the live API: gpt-5.5 rejects any non-default temperature on /v1/responses (HTTP 400, param=temperature, 'Unsupported parameter'); temperature=1 and omitting it both return 200. DeepSeek accepts 0.7. null = parameter omitted, model default used.

This asymmetry is admissible ONLY because each engine is scored as its own population and never pooled (D-080 / C-12). It must be disclosed wherever neutral-lane results are reported, and never silently normalized away.
Cross-engine differences in frame prevalence confound sampling with model identity; no cross-engine comparison may be drawn from the Phase 0 run.
